info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Parking Reservations Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Status API allows users to retrieve the current status of parking reservations in real time. This endpoint serves as a valuable resource for consumers such as parking operators and application developers, enabling them to check reservation states and manage availability efficiently. The API responds with detailed information about each reservation, including its status, duration, and associated vehicle details. Use cases include monitoring parking occupancy, customer service inquiries, and integration with mobile applications for enhanced user experiences.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of a reservation.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the status of a specific reservation. It provides detailed information about the reservation's current state, which can help determine if the reservation is confirmed, pending, or canceled.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of reservations. Ensure that the request is constructed correctly to receive the desired reservation status information.

200.description: The current status of the reservations has been successfully retrieved.
